identity_check: Confirmed as Apprentice.io (apprentice.io; brand 'Apprentice', LinkedIn page links apprentice.io), Jersey City NJ (101 Hudson St.), co-founded December 2014 by Angelo Stracquatanio, Gary Pignata and Alexandra Buttke; cloud manufacturing execution software for GMP / life-science manufacturing. Every round page names the same Jersey City company (Series A release from Apprentice.io; VC News Daily datelines Jersey City). Not an apprenticeship / training platform, and not Ganymede: Apprentice acquired Ganymede.bio in January 2026 (it is the acquirer). Category changed adjacent -> direct (layer stays plant_ops): since 2025-26 the company sells A1, 'The AI Agent for Manufacturing Teams' ('Respond to alarms, troubleshoot faster, eliminate paperwork'), with Maintenance, Supply Chain, Quality and Process sub-agents marketed to general manufacturers, not only pharma; that is the same job as Utopian's maintenance / procurement / process-stability agents, though sold into enterprise GMP plants and not over WhatsApp.
